project.name: GJS Python Rest Client archetype
project.description:
-------------------------------------------------------- Project gjs-python-rest-client-archetype --------------------------------------------------------
Archetype to generate the basic structure of a simple project in language python. Example of use: This command generates the test-project project:
mvn -B archetype:generate \ -DarchetypeGroupId=org.gjsoft.maven.archetypes \ -DarchetypeArtifactId=gjs-python-rest-client-archetype \ -DarchetypeVersion=1.0.0 \ -DshortName=test-project \ -DgroupId=org.gjsoft.test \ -DmainFunction=Main:main \ -Dauthor="GJ Software" \ -DauthorMail=gjsoft@gmx.es \ -Dhost=localhost \ -Dport=8000
==================================================================================== Archetype Parameters:
* shortName: Name of the project. Always lowercase. Allows two words separated by a hyphen.
* groupId: The group of the project artifact.
* artifactId: The name of the project artifact. Default is java-module. Not required.
* package: The project packaging of the source code. Default is org.gjs.maven.archetypes. Not required.
* version: The project version. Default is 1.0.0-SNAPSHOT. Not required.
* mainFunction: The main executable function. Default is Main:main. Not required.
* author: The author of the project. Not required.
* authorMail: The e-mail of the author of the project. Not required.
* host: The host IP or DNS name of the REST Servrer. Default: localhost. Not required.
* port: The port of the REST Servrer. Default: 8000. Not required. ====================================================================================
